# GoodAlexander company model API

Documentation: https://goodalexander.com/api/
Base URL: https://api.corbanu.com
Live plan/price: GET /v1/company-model-plan (public)
Launch: USD 200 per UTC calendar month, unlimited accepted-model reads, 10 successful reads per rolling minute per account.
Authentication: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_CORBANU_API_KEY. Never put credentials in URLs or public output.
POST /v1/company-model-subscription buys one month from prepaid balance; requires X-Corbanu-Confirm-Monthly-Usd matching the live monthlyUsd quote. Explicit renewal, no automatic payment.
GET /v1/company-model-subscription returns active period, fixed charge and successful call count.
GET /v1/company-models lists accepted model IDs, source dates and SHA-256 versions.
GET /v1/company-models/{model_id}/outputs returns the accepted, filtered model with source_date, version and output.
Missing/invalid keys: 401. Inactive subscription: 402. Withheld/stale: 409. Rate limit: 429 with Retry-After. Source unavailable: 503.
No per-read fee. Refused reads are not counted. HEAD is 405. Reused request IDs are 409.
Model source age limit: 7 days. Third-party and trading-performance fields are excluded.
Trade idea: none is published at the moment; a dated idea page and evidence record will be listed here after publication.
NAVCoin Buy is disabled until sprint 7's purchase route is live. Newsletter signup does not issue an API key.
